# aiweather

> The live status of every AI, as weather. aiweather reads the official status pages of 48 AI companies (the model
> labs, the clouds that serve their models, coding tools and creative tools) and draws them as one live sky: clear
> when everything works, clouds, rain and storms as things break.

- Official sources only: each company's own status page, read with an honest User-Agent. Nothing behind bot
  protection is bypassed.
- Nothing made up: a page that can't be read shows "Couldn't check", never "Clear". Uptime figures are the ones the
  companies publish; where a page publishes only incident history, the figure is worked out from the official
  incident times and labelled that way.
- Each company is checked about once a minute. No accounts, no tracking, no database.

## API

- [Snapshot](https://aiweather.synteq.app/api/snapshot): every company's current state, as JSON
- [Uptime](https://aiweather.synteq.app/api/uptime): official daily history and uptime figures (`/api/uptime/{id}` for one company)
- [News](https://aiweather.synteq.app/api/news): each company's latest official news (`/api/news/{id}` for one company)
- [Health](https://aiweather.synteq.app/api/health): readiness, and each source's last success, error and latency
- `wss://aiweather.synteq.app/ws`: a snapshot on connect, then each change as it happens
